capabilities: Set a custom color on any file or folder from the explorer context menu
Toggle cascading colors down an item's folder tree
Set the default color shown in the picker for new files and folders
extras: A favorites list for quick color access is listed under Upcoming and not yet available; the README invites feature requests and pull requests.
motivation: The author used CSS snippets for this but hit limitations with per-item targeting, maintenance on new files, and unloaded explorer items, so they built a more reliable plugin.
problem: Coloring explorer items with CSS snippets requires nth-child or name selectors, breaks when files are added, and fails when Obsidian unloads out-of-view explorer items.

relations.evidence: I would like to thank FlorianWoelki and the rest of the Obsidian Iconize developers

summary: File explorer colorizer that lets users assign custom colors to individual files and folders via a right-click context menu.
